description: Frozen FLAN-T5-Large candidate protocol. It records raw, order-averaged binary component evidence and does not itself promote components into final coarse labels.

scope_firm.definition: The article describes a material information-shock component that primarily concerns exactly one firm, either the target company or one sector peer.
scope_firm.decision_rule: Answer yes for a one-firm component even when a separate common component also exists. Company membership in a sector is not by itself evidence of a common component.

scope_common.definition: The article explicitly describes a material information-shock component that applies to several firms, the target sector as a whole, or the broad market or economy.
scope_common.decision_rule: Answer no when the article concerns only one firm. Answer yes for a common component even when a separate one-firm component also exists.

event_earnings_guidance.definition: The article describes reported financial results, forecasts, outlook, or company guidance.
event_earnings_guidance.decision_rule: Answer yes only when this event family is explicitly present in the article.

event_product_demand.definition: The article describes products, technology, customers, contracts, sales demand, or end-market demand.
event_product_demand.decision_rule: Answer yes only when this event family is explicitly present in the article.

event_supply_capacity.definition: The article describes supply chains, production or manufacturing capacity, production constraints, or inventory availability.
event_supply_capacity.decision_rule: Answer yes only when this event family is explicitly present in the article.

event_regulation_legal.definition: The article describes regulation, trade policy, litigation, governance, or legal or operational compliance matters.
event_regulation_legal.decision_rule: Answer yes only when this event family is explicitly present in the article.

event_corporate_analyst.definition: The article describes an analyst action or a corporate action such as a merger, acquisition, financing, restructuring, buyback, dividend, or management change.
event_corporate_analyst.decision_rule: Answer yes only when this event family is explicitly present in the article.

event_macro_market.definition: The article describes a macroeconomic or broad-market development.
event_macro_market.decision_rule: Answer yes only when this event family is explicitly present in the article.

alignment_same.definition: The article explicitly states that the target company and its sector or one or more sector peers are affected in the same direction.
alignment_same.decision_rule: Answer no when the relationship is not explicit. Do not predict returns or infer a relationship from sector membership alone.

alignment_opposite.definition: The article explicitly states that the target company benefits at the expense of its sector peers, or that peers benefit at the target company's expense.
alignment_opposite.decision_rule: Answer no when the relationship is not explicit. Do not predict returns or infer competitive effects from external knowledge.

prompt_contract.source_rule: Use only the supplied article and target metadata. Do not use external facts, later events, remembered outcomes, historical prices, or predictions.
prompt_contract.positive_rule: Answer yes only when the component definition is supported by explicit article text.
prompt_contract.negative_rule: Answer no when the component is absent, merely possible, or unsupported by the supplied text.
prompt_contract.output_rule: Answer with exactly one option letter and nothing else.
